Setting.TimerSoundHint: A chime when the Architect's or an epilogue's time runs out.

Notify.NoGM: An active GM is needed to keep the shared state.
Notify.NoEntities: There are no entities at the table.
Notify.NotEntity: Only an entity can be dropped here.

Consent.Title: Change an entity
Consent.Ask: {from} wants to change your entity «{name}» for a shard. Agree?

Entity.NoSummary: Roll a d10 on the three tables or enter digits.
Entity.ChangeTip: Spend a shard to change your entity
Entity.ChangeHint: An entity can change but is never destroyed.
Entity.NeverDestroyed: An entity cannot be destroyed — only changed.

Setup.Title: In a Hurry!
Setup.Lead: Assembling the Mosaic: safety, entities, Queries, Task.
Setup.EntitiesLead: Each player creates one entity. The order below is the seating order.
Setup.DropHint: Or drag an existing entity here — from the Actors tab or a compendium.

Safety.Title: Safety
Safety.Lead: Agree on what's OK and what's off the table. The X-card is always at hand.
Safety.XCardTip: X-card: pause the timer and remove the moment — no explanation needed
Safety.XCardHint: Someone raised the X-card. The timer is paused — remove the last moment, no explanations.

Query.Title: Queries
Query.Label: Query
Query.Lead: Everyone invents the Query for the entity of the player on their right: a question it will seek an answer to across dimensions.
Query.NeedSeats: Queries appear once there are at least two entities.
Query.AnsweredTip: The entity found its answer — record it and take a new Query

Quest.Title: Task
Quest.Label: Task
Quest.Lead: A shared goal leading everyone through the dimensions. It may change along the way.
Quest.Placeholder: E.g. find who stole the Moon

Options.Title: Options
Options.DecayHint: Decay: each next Architect gets 5 seconds less. When it reaches zero, the Mosaic is complete.

Phase.EpilogueLead: Each in turn has 30 seconds to tell what became of their entity.
Phase.EpilogueHint: 30 seconds — what happened to the entity after it all?
Phase.ResetAsk: Start a new game? Entities stay, the table state resets.

Dimension.Label: Dimension
Dimension.Hint: The previous Architect passes the role to whoever they like (or to whoever shouted).
Dimension.NoneYet: To begin, someone has to shout «New dimension!»

Timer.MonologueRule: Only the Architect speaks. Everyone else listens without interrupting — and may note realities down.
Timer.MonologueEndHint: The Architect gets a shard. Now everyone plays.

Reality.Placeholder: A new reality of this dimension…
Reality.PlaceholderArch: What is true in this dimension?
Reality.ChangeTip: Spend a shard to change this reality
Reality.ChangeHint: The old reality is struck out, the new one becomes true.

Shard.Title: Shards

Reason.query: a step toward the Query's answer

Shard.GiveTip: Give a shard to another entity
